title: 17549 - 17549/P1141/004417
engines: Tüm VAG Benzinli (TSI/TFSI) ve Dizel (TDI) Motorlar
commonCauses: MAF Emiş Hava Akış Sensörü Sensör Okuma Değerleri (G70) OR Manifold Pressure Sensör Okuma Değerleri (G71) faulty
stepByStepSolution: Kontrol edin:  MAF Emiş Hava Akış Sensörü Sensör Okuma Değerleri (G70) OR Manifold Pressure Sensör Okuma Değerleri (G71)
Kontrol edin:  Engine Operating Conditions => Meas. Blocks
technicalNotes: Uwe: I think this code is set when the airflow being measured (or otherwise calculated) by the ECU doesn't make sense given other operating parameters such as RPM and throttle opening, manifold pressure, etc.
model: 911, Passat, Golf, Tiguan, Polo, Arteon, Touareg, Transporter, Caddy, Amarok, Scirocco, Jetta, A3, A4, A5, A6, A7, A8, Q3, Q5, Q7, Q8, TT, Leon, Ibiza, Ateca, Arona, Tarraco, Octavia, Superb, Kodiaq, Karoq, Fabia, Scala, Cayenne, Macan, Panamera, Taycan
